business_problem: Aflac Japan faces challenges recruiting and retaining skilled insurance agency representatives and helping them prepare suitable customer proposals amid a declining working population.
solution_summary: Aflac Japan uses Salesforce Agentforce to help insurance representatives prepare proposals and digitize customer conversations. The story says newcomers can make appropriate proposals like experienced representatives and present insurance plans instantly. Data 360 gives Aflac a way to use information from inside and outside the company across multiple platforms. The page lists Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, MuleSoft, and Salesforce Professional Services as products used, but does not explain their specific roles in this story. It does not name source systems, connectors, model versions, storage components, or an end-to-end data processing architecture; the concrete implementation described is Agentforce-supported proposal preparation drawing on data available through Data 360.
